text: Illustrate the story here: Do Not Quit! Quint is next to run. He is on a quest to win. He can not quit. "You can not quit," said his mom. "You can do it," said his dad. Quint runs fast. He can see the end. "You can do it," said his dad. Quint gets to the end and wins. "Yes! I went fast! I did the best!" said Quint.
